info.name: PWA Suite & Customizer
info.summary: PWA customizer and manager for Nextcloud
info.description:
PWA Suite lets you fully customize the Progressive Web App (PWA) experience of your Nextcloud instance:
- Custom manifest.json configuration (name, icons, theme and background colors). - Every Nextcloud app gets its own manifest id, so each app can be installed as a separate PWA. - Custom Service Worker registration and control. - Optimized install experience on mobile and desktop devices.
info.author: Manuel Bernal Carvajal
